Your music now flows from one song to the next, and your playlists can travel with you.

## New

- **Gapless playback.** The next song is ready before the current one ends, so there is no silence in between. Always on.
- **Crossfade.** Let the end of one song fade into the start of the next, from 1 to 12 seconds. Find it in Settings > Audio Quality; it is off until you turn it on. Songs that follow each other on the same album never crossfade, so live albums and mixes stay as they were made.
- **Soft play and pause.** Music fades in when you press play and fades out when you pause, instead of starting and stopping abruptly. Unplugging your headphones still stops it right away.
- **Export as .m3u.** Tap the three dots on a playlist or on Favourites and choose Export as .m3u. VLC, Poweramp, foobar2000 and most other players can open the file.

## Improved

- **Yoru's page now comes down from the top** when you open it.
- **Skipping to another song** fades the old one out instead of cutting it off.
